title: DeepSeek V4-Flash API Enters Public Beta, Outperforming GPT in Speed and Cost-Effectiveness

content_html:
Recently, DeepSeek officially announced that its latest version of API is now open for testing. As a highly anticipated AI product, the new version has achieved a groundbreaking upgrade in proxy capabilities, with baseline test results even surpassing previous preview versions, demonstrating an extremely strong overall strength.

In practical application tests, an AI deep developer was the first to integrate the new version of the API into the system for testing. The results showed that when facing the same high-difficulty complex tasks and prompts, the new version completed the task efficiently in about 40 seconds, while overseas top-tier large models took 1 minute and 47 seconds. Although overseas models still have a slight advantage in some aspects of output quality, the delivery speed and usability of the new version have already reached industry-leading standards.

Aside from the impressive processing speed, price and cost have also become core highlights of this update. According to the official's latest pricing mechanism, the input cost of some versions has dropped significantly, with a substantial overall reduction. However, different versions have their own strategies, with some high-performance or specific time period API costs adjusted accordingly. Overall, compared to mainstream overseas official large models, domestic AI still maintains a highly competitive advantage in API pricing, with cost differences generally ranging from tens to hundreds of times.

Industry insiders analyze that as domestic large models continue to break through in performance, speed, and cost control, the commercialization threshold of AI technology is further decreasing. In the future, more developers and enterprises will be able to enjoy efficient AI computing power at extremely low costs, and the industry ecosystem may witness a new round of reshaping.

content_html_zh:
近日，DeepSeek官方宣布其最新版本的API现已开放测试。 作为一款备受期待的AI产品，新版本在代理能力上实现了突破性升级，基线测试结果甚至超越了之前的预览版本，展现出极其强大的整体实力。

在实际应用测试中，AI深度开发者率先将新版本API集成到系统中进行测试。 结果显示，面对同样高难度的复杂任务和提示，新版本在40秒左右高效完成任务，而海外顶级大型机型则需要1分47秒。 虽然海外机型在输出品质的某些方面仍略占优势，但新版本的交付速度和易用性已经达到行业领先水平。

除了令人印象深刻的处理速度之外，价格和成本也成为了本次更新的核心亮点。 根据官方最新的定价机制，部分版本的投入成本大幅下降，整体大幅降低。 但不同版本有各自的策略，一些高性能或特定时间段的API成本会相应调整。 总体来看，相比海外主流官方大机型，国产AI在API定价上仍保持着高度竞争优势，成本差异普遍在数十倍至数百倍不等。

业内人士分析，随着国产大型机型在性能、速度、成本控制等方面不断突破，AI技术的商业化门槛进一步降低。 未来，更多的开发者和企业将能够以极低的成本享受高效的AI算力，行业生态或将迎来新一轮重塑。
